anti_patterns.mistake: Unchecked npx execution polluting JSON-RPC stdout with colored notices and ANSI escape sequences
anti_patterns.root_cause: npx in modern npm writes colored notices to stdout when not silenced, breaking JSON-RPC parsing (invalid character '\x1b')
anti_patterns.strategy: Always wrap Node-based MCP servers using mcp-npx with NO_COLOR=1, npm_config_loglevel=silent, and --silent flag
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: NEVER run raw npx for MCP STDIO processes; always use mcp-npx wrapper.

anti_patterns.mistake: Sentry MCP server falling back to interactive OAuth device code flow and hanging
anti_patterns.root_cause: @sentry/mcp-server defaults to interactive device code login if --access-token or SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN is omitted
anti_patterns.strategy: Pass --access-token ${SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN} explicitly in CLI arguments and provide environment fallback
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Always explicitly supply auth tokens via CLI flags when MCP server defaults to interactive browser/device-code login.

anti_patterns.mistake: Codebase indexer scanning self-extracting archive payload and inflating codebase database to 40MB+
anti_patterns.root_cause: Scanning binary payloads or packed archive files in analyze.py treats binary blobs as source text
anti_patterns.strategy: Exclude *.tar.gz, *.tar.xz, install.sh, and dist/ in codebase indexing routines
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Always configure self-exclusion lists in static analyzers and file crawlers for binary/build artifacts.

anti_patterns.mistake: Leaving MCP servers running permanently in background consuming CPU and RAM
anti_patterns.root_cause: Static mcp_config.json with default background servers creates memory bloat and port collisions
anti_patterns.strategy: Zero-Default profile: start with empty mcpServers ({}), enable dynamically on-demand, and auto-close upon task completion
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Default mcp_config.json must remain empty (0 active servers). Enable servers dynamically and disable immediately after turn.

anti_patterns.mistake: Agent looping over view_file sequentially to understand an entire folder codebase
anti_patterns.root_cause: Sequential view_file calls waste context tokens and cause high latency
anti_patterns.strategy: Execute analyze.py --check --auto-heal --inject-ki and read the consolidated codebase_summary.md in a single read
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: NEVER call view_file recursively across multiple files in a folder; use codebase_summary.md.

anti_patterns.mistake: Refactoring code outside the user's requested scope
anti_patterns.root_cause: Agent interprets adjacent code as needing improvement or unsolicited optimization.
anti_patterns.strategy: Blast Radius Lock: Declare edit scope upfront; only edit within declared scope; flag out-of-scope issues as follow-up recommendations.
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Never touch or refactor files or functions outside the declared blast radius without explicit user authorization.

anti_patterns.mistake: Claiming success without running verification commands
anti_patterns.root_cause: Token-pressure or speed bias leads agent to skip test runs and pattern-match 'this looks right' or use speculative language.
anti_patterns.strategy: Evidence Gate: Always run tests or re-read files, report actual terminal output, never say 'should work'.
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Zero speculative claims: every declaration of success requires empirical terminal execution evidence.

anti_patterns.mistake: Editing files based on stale cached memory instead of current on-disk state
anti_patterns.root_cause: Files read early in long sessions get modified externally or by background tasks while agent remembers old lines.
anti_patterns.strategy: Freshness Gate: Re-read target file if >5 tool calls since last read; run git status before multi-file edits.
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Always re-read target files before applying diffs if >5 tool calls elapsed or external changes occurred.

anti_patterns.mistake: Using invented library functions that don't exist in installed packages
anti_patterns.root_cause: LLM hallucination on fast-moving libraries or niche frameworks where training memory contains plausible APIs.
anti_patterns.strategy: Hallucination Guard: Verify every unfamiliar API symbol via tool inspection, REPL check, or docs before using.
anti_patterns.invariant_rule: Verify all library APIs and methods via tools before writing code; pass Import Verification Gate.
